summary: The Gateway interpretation port runs Sol first and Gemini free only after a technical failure of Sol (subscription OAuth for OpenAI models, Gemini pinned to its free profile); Luna leaves the interpretation chain and stays in the immune chain. The Pulse room purpose accepts the same models as the owner path, restricted only to the Pulse catalogue.
reason: Amine 29/10: all models may receive Pulse professional data, no exception per contact, Sol then Gemini fallback (S24 decision event 4716eb45…). Paired with the playbooks change interpreter-sol-then-gemini-20261029.

tests.name: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/scripts/test-intent-interpreter-port.cjs
tests.evidence: Sol answers first with OAuth; each technical failure of Sol falls back once to Gemini without OAuth; Luna is no longer an interpretation model; the Pulse room accepts Sol and Gemini on the Pulse catalogue and refuses Luna, a plain message, an owner catalogue or malformed JSON.

tests.name: openclaw-plugin-mobile-ui/scripts/test-brain-only-entry.cjs
tests.evidence: Under brain-only the room interpretation survives with Sol; Luna, a plain message or an owner catalogue are refused with zero completion.

capabilities.reason: Same intents; the interpreting model order changes.

architecture.reason: Same Gateway port and credential owner; model constants change.

limitations: Activate the paired playbooks change with this deployment (the governor selects Sol first).
Sol latency on real turns to be measured after deployment.
rollback: Revert this commit and redeploy the core; revert the paired playbooks change.
